method_en: The v6.3 branch-aware knockout pipeline combines pre-match evidence, expert-panel reasoning, conditional MAS rollout, and Monte Carlo sampling across normal time, extra time, and penalties.
architecture_en: Extra time and penalties are modeled as conditional branches of the same knockout path tree rather than as separate post-processing outputs. The frontend tabs show different slices of one unified path distribution.
